title: LinkedIn — founder POV on representing both sides
hook: People ask how we can represent buyers and sellers in the same market without it being a conflict.
body:
People ask how we can represent buyers and sellers in the same market without it being a conflict.

Here's the honest answer: because the job isn't to win a side. It's to tell the truth about the airplane and the market, every time, to whoever we're sitting across from.

When you've valued the same tail from both directions, you stop guessing. You know what a clean logbook is worth, what a deferred inspection really costs, and where the number lands when emotion leaves the room. That's not a conflict — that's the whole edge.

Representation on every side of the deal, with the same data and the same standard. That's the firm we wanted to build.
cta: Questions on value? That's the conversation we love to have.
